items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Duke Ellington, Dizzy Gillespie, Dave Brubeck

ctx.x: It really is, that’s right, you’re right about that.

I mean we look at even the U.S government. When they want ambassadors, goodwill ambassadors, who do they send out? Jazz musicians. Duke Ellington, Dizzy Gillespie, Dave Brubeck, send out the-because they know that this music has a power and a force and I think that is what they recognize in McCoy Tyner is that he is a living, breathing, continuing to bring the magic of this music to the people. So what can we expect, I know that in a couple of days, three days you’re going to have your eighty-third birthday?
